name: Daxerhof
beschreibung:
Surrounded by sunny meadows and the picturesque backdrop of the Kitzbuehel Alps, Daxerhof in Erpfendorf welcomes visitors with genuine Tyrolean warmth. Comfortably designed accommodations offer a cosy home for families and nature lovers.

Children love interacting with farm animals and discovering farm life. Summer invites exploration of trails and swimming lakes, while winter brings quick access to ski areas and cross-country tracks.
kurzbeschreibung: Daxerhof in Erpfendorf provides authentic farm holiday charm and warm hospitality in the Kitzbuehel Alps.
